review_note: Read the test line by line and recomputed every sha256: receipt, manifest, test, console log and the manifest sources all match the current files and the fragment columns. The console log shows passed=65, failed=0, errors=0, skipped=0, and no live-Julia claim is made. Oracle: a base-R dense Laplace marginal likelihood with NB2 score and weights hand-derived (size = sigma^-2). It is evaluated at the fitted beta, sigma, per-tip SDs and fitted rho, on two seeds (60 tips each, 960 observations). The kernel is hand-built as cov2cor(ape::vcv(tree)) with tree tips shuffled relative to the factor levels. It is checked against the package helper drm_phylo_tip_covariance (1e-8); the oracle itself never uses the helper. Oracle gaps are 1.4e-10 and 1.9e-8 against a 1e-4 tolerance. Emulated-bug sensitivity is asserted at more than 0.1 for swapped SDs, reversed SD vector, rho dropped, rho sign flipped, raw vcv instead of correlation, kernel by level position, and kernel in tree-tip order. The smallest observed gap is 1.26. A refit with the SD predictors swapped also moves logLik by more than 0.1. Linked rows are actually fitted: phylo(1 + x | p | id, tree = tree) in mu with the labelled p, one SD formula per coefficient, shared rho estimated and nested against the unlabelled fit. Both mu:I and mu:x1 are covered, as one correlated pair. The constant-SD nesting oracle check (1e-4) is included. The decision not to link phylo_labelled_block and the sigma rows is reasonable (sigma is intercept-only here). What this does NOT establish: phylo_covariance_matrix or phylo_precision_matrix inputs (tree only); animal, relmat, spatial or mesh; SDs in sigma, or a labelled sigma block; any link other than log; calibration of SEs or intervals, coverage, or estimator recovery (only two seeds; rho direction is checked on one pair, and the marginal simulate check is only a pooled cross-covariance within 0.12 of rho from 300 draws via internal helpers); Julia parity or live-Julia; matching_provider_label semantics; and ordinary random effects combined with the block (refusal only).
